name: Howden
verdict: An employee-owned insurance group: employees are the largest shareholder group, with long-term minority outside investors.
note: UK insurance broker. Tier 2 Global Partner of Emirates Great Britain SailGP Team (Howden news, 25 February 2026); presenter of the Neom Turf Cup and the Red Sea Turf Handicap presenter is Longines. Ownership per its own 'Our shareholders' page: employees are the largest shareholder group (~30%); minority investors General Atlantic, La Caisse (formerly CDPQ, a Quebec public pension fund) and Hg; the Howden Foundation also holds shares.
